name: Isozaki Mie
source:
Mie is the younger daughter of the former manager of "Hotaru Sou" apartment building, who recently died in a car accident. She is quite worried about her older sister Mana. Although Mie is still young, she helps to reduce the burden on her sister as much as possible. Mie is waiting for someone to appear, a person who will support and help them cope with their hardship.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3560]Getchu[/url].]
